objective: Qualify a real-source finite native-replay adapter and compare existing graph closure with an equally informed direct ledger.
disclosure: Known historical Ogma boundary example; prospective adapter/control protocol, not blinded discovery or an independent flight requirement approval.
fulltext: The vehicle shall always satisfy kias >= 0.0

domain.encoding: IEEE-754 binary32; native input bits independently checked
domain.monitor_reset: Fresh native process per trace, including certificate verification
domain.observation: Cumulative violation callbacks after each sample; past-always includes current sample

comparison: Both arms receive the same independently reexecuted native tables, source identity, domain and revocation events. Record shared acquisition counts/time and separate closure time. This cannot establish evidence-discovery, human-cost, architectural or economic superiority.
positive_boundary: Finite exhaustive observation under declared compiler/runtime assumptions, not an unbounded C proof, Lean proof of this adapter, or mission approval.
source_caveat: Original FRET fixture has four blank Copilot assignments. Both native monitors came from the same derived input supplying those assignments; the requirement itself is unchanged.
